display.name: HADES-SRAM Configuration
display.description: Configure separated SRAM ports, analytical timing, maintenance, and generated RTL or IP artifacts.
display.help: Timing and bandwidth are analytical estimates, not implementation or board signoff. See docs/hades_sram_generator.md for integration guidance.

pages.title: Integration
pages.description: Select the generated target and integration contract.

fields.label: &Target:
fields.description: rtl emits standalone RTL; ip emits configure Tcl and a wrapper for an already packaged Vivado catalog IP.

fields.label: &Module name:
fields.description: SystemVerilog top-level module identifier.

fields.label: &IP name:
fields.description: Vivado IP name; used only for the ip target.

fields.label: &Configuration mode:
fields.description: CSR enables runtime registers; STATIC uses hard-wired parameters.

fields.label: Physical &ports:
fields.description: Number of separated SRAM interfaces. Backend bounds apply.

fields.label: &Address width (bits):
fields.description: Frontend word-address width.

pages.title: SRAM Ports
pages.description: Edit width, depth, enables, and automatic or manual backend addressing.

fields.label: Address &mode:
fields.description: Automatic packs and normalizes on explicit edits; Manual preserves concrete bases and raw tails.

fields.label: &Width (bits):
fields.description: Frontend width for the selected port.

fields.label: &Depth (frontend words):
fields.description: Capacity in frontend words; backend derives lane counts and raw size.

fields.label: &Base (64-byte beats):
fields.description: Manual backend base; Automatic mode keeps this read-only.

fields.label: &Byte enable
fields.description: Expose byte-write enables for this port.

fields.label: &Enabled
fields.description: Include this physical port in the active schedule.

pages.title: Clock & Latency
pages.description: Configure the shared port clock, read latency, and analytical period model.

fields.label: Clock &mode:
fields.description: SYNC requires same-source static-phase clocks; ASYNC uses the CDC integration.

fields.label: Port clock (&Hz):
fields.description: Requested external port clock, typically 100000–500000 Hz; backend bounds apply.

fields.label: Read &latency (cycles):
fields.description: Exact frontend response latency in port clock cycles.

fields.label: &Target period (ui_clk cycles):
fields.description: Manual schedule target; editing disables automatic derivation.

fields.label: M&inimum period (ui_clk cycles):
fields.description: Manual clock-monitor minimum; editing disables automatic derivation.

pages.title: Maintenance & Self-Test
pages.description: Configure refresh, ZQ calibration, and optional built-in self-test.

fields.label: Enable &self-test
fields.description: Self-test supports only 32/64-bit widths for EVERY PHYSICAL PORT, including runtime-disabled ports.

fields.label: Self-test &block (frontend words):
fields.description: Words per self-test block.

fields.label: &Refresh period (ui_clk cycles):
fields.description: Refresh scheduler interval; derived time appears below.

fields.label: &ZQ calibration (port_clk periods):
fields.description: ZQ calibration interval; derived time appears below.

pages.title: Review & Generate
pages.description: Review diagnostics, analytical timing, memory layout, bandwidth, and read-only artifacts before generation.

fields.label: &Output directory:
fields.description: Destination for generated artifacts; nothing is written before Finish.

fields.label: &Overwrite existing managed artifacts
fields.description: Allow generation to replace its managed output set.

fields.label: &Copy complete integration sources
fields.description: Copy all maintained RTL, clock constraints, and integration references. Uncheck for configuration-specific artifacts only.

reports.title: Diagnostics
reports.description: Backend errors and warnings with exact configuration paths.

reports.title: Exact-L timing and TDMA schedule
reports.description: Raw analytical clock, latency, budget, and nominal slot values.

reports.title: Memory map and backend window padding
reports.description: Raw base, size, tail, padding, and capacity values for every port.

reports.title: Configured bandwidth
reports.description: Configured frontend and allocated backend demand, not measured throughput.

reports.title: Read-only artifact preview
reports.description: Ordered in-memory generated source artifacts; preview performs no writes.
